name: Upper Hudson

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A large upstate New York AVA of about 1,500 square miles, in all or parts of seven counties including Albany. At the outset it had 19 vineyards on about 67.5 acres, planted to cold-hardy grapes such as Marquette, Frontenac, La Crescent and La Crosse.
